independenceBoundary: Python independently implements HTTP range receipts, EOCD and ZIP64 parsing, local-header agreement, raw-Deflate XYPT extraction, four-column validation, AVI header scanning, counter comparison, and result comparison. Both implementations necessarily call the same installed 7-Zip 22.01 Deflate64 decoder; decoder diversity is not claimed.

executionOrder.gate: All seven count, hash, stable-prefix, and native-counter comparisons must pass before any L0002 request.
Use the L0001-complete global transfer upper bound exactly; no parser or range rule changes are permitted.
All seven comparisons must pass and the global cumulative transfer upper bound must remain at or below 134217728 bytes.

fixedHoldoutProcedure.xypt: CRC-verify the complete XYPT_L0002.csv, require every nonempty row to contain four finite numeric fields, and require fourth-column integer masks from 0 through 255.
fixedHoldoutProcedure.avi: From the L0002 local-header offset, request nested 4194304-byte and 8388608-byte archive segments, decode both as deliberately truncated Deflate64 ZIPs, discard 65536 emitted tail bytes, and require retained-prefix identity.
fixedHoldoutProcedure.frameCount: Require avih.dwTotalFrames, video strh.dwLength, and dmlh.dwTotalFrames to exist and agree. No preferred-counter rescue is allowed.
fixedHoldoutProcedure.slotIdentity: A count deficit remains set-valued unless a documented per-frame trigger key appears in the already frozen stable header. Image pixels may not be inspected in RC43.
fixedHoldoutProcedure.verdicts: Apply H1-H4 without modification. H5 passes only if Python and JavaScript reproduce both layers and no rule changes after L0002 inspection.

stopRules: Do not request L0002 if L0001 independent comparison fails.
Do not request a complete AVI or TIFF member.
Stop if either retained prefix disagrees, any native frame counter differs, or any XYPT row is skipped.
Stop before any request that would raise the conservative global transfer upper bound above 134217728 bytes.
Preserve every failed output or amendment before changing code.
